skills.name: Crash Course
skills.description: Chip rams his hovercraft into the ground, dealing <font color='#3B69FF'>(Magic Damage)</font> equal to 150 plus 5% of target's Max HP and applying <font color='#404495'>(Chip's Mark)</font> on enemy heroes hit. Chip gains a 300<font color='#27C0C7'>( +60% Total Magic Power)</font> Shield upon hitting an enemy hero, which increases by 25% for each additional enemy hero hit. Chip's next Basic Attack will become ranged and also hit all nearby enemies with <font color='#404495'>(Chip's Mark)</font>, detonating the mark to deal 200<font color='#27C0C7'>( +40% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color='#3B69FF'>(Magic Damage)</font> and stun each target for 0.6s.

skills.name: Overtime
skills.description:
Chip rushes for 2s, gaining up to 65% extra Movement Speed, after which he maintains the max speed for 2s.
Chip's next Basic Attack will cause him to charge at the enemy, dealing 200<font color='#27C0C7'>( +30% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color='#3B69FF'>(Magic Damage)</font> and knocking them back slightly.

skills.name: Shortcut
skills.description:
Chip drops the <font color='#404495'>(Main Portal)</font> on an enemy hero, dealing 200<font color='#27C0C7'>( +60% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color='#3B69FF'>(Magic Damage)</font> and slowing them by 25%. The Main Portal deals 2 times the damage and slow effect after a delay. Meanwhile, he creates <font color='#404495'>(Connecting Portals)</font> near allied heroes (10 units away) and behind the allied Base. The <font color='#404495'>(Main Portal)</font> and <font color='#404495'>(Connecting Portals)</font> last up to 15s.
<font color='#404495'>(Connecting Portal)</font>: Heroes (on both teams) can teleport from <font color='#404495'>(Connecting Portals)</font> to the <font color='#404495'>(Main Portal)</font>, and allied heroes gain Burst Movement Speed for 1.5s.
<font color='#404495'>(Main Portal)</font>: The Main Portal inherits 70% of Chip's attributes. Heroes can stand on the <font color='#404495'>(Main Portal)</font> for 2s to return to the <font color='#404495'>(Connecting Portal)</font> they came from. Casting skills or launching Basic Attacks will reset the stand time.

skills.name: Snack Time!
skills.description: Chip starts eating potato chips once every 2s when out of combat, regenerating HP equal to 300 plus 15% of lost HP after finishing a whole bag (requires 4 bites). After eating a bag of chips, Chip will be full and cannot eat again for 5s. (The bite count will be saved if he enters combat before finishing a whole bag.)

items.name: Athena's Shield
items.des: Unique Passive - Shield: Upon taking Magic Damage, gains 25% Magic Damage Reduction for 3s (applied before taking damage). Regains this effect 5s after leaving combat.

items.name: Antique Cuirass
items.des: Unique Passive - Deter: When hit by a skill, reduces the attacker's Physical Damage by 4% for 2s (this effect stacks up to 3 times).

items.name: Dominance Ice
items.des: Unique Passive - Arctic Cold: Reduces the Attack Speed of nearby enemy heroes to 70% of normal.

items.name: Immortality
items.des: Unique Passive - Immortal: Revives 2.5s after death, gaining 16% Max HP and a 220-1200 shield (scales with level) that lasts 3s (210s cooldown).

items.name: Cursed Helmet
items.des: Unique Passive - Burning Soul: Deals Magic Damage equal to 0.6% of the hero's Max HP per second to nearby enemies. This damage is increased by 140% to 350% against creeps and minions (scales with level).
